scripts.boundaries:check: depcruise --config packages/config/dependency-cruiser.mjs apps packages && node scripts/rust/boundaries.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm execution:test && pnpm adapters:test && pnpm database:test && pnpm execution-reference:test && pnpm boundaries:test && pnpm --filter @workspace/web test
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm boundaries:check && pnpm docs:check && pnpm build && pnpm rust:check && pnpm api:contract
scripts.execution:test: pnpm --filter @workspace/application... build && pnpm --filter @workspace/contracts build && tsc --project packages/contracts/test/tsconfig.json && node --test packages/application/test/*.test.mjs packages/contracts/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.database:test: pnpm db:build && node --test packages/database/test/target.test.mjs scripts/test/database-docker.test.mjs scripts/test/target-parity.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter @workspace/database... --filter @workspace/application... build && node scripts/database/integration.mjs && node scripts/database/identity-integration.mjs
scripts.web:check: pnpm --filter @workspace/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/web test && pnpm --filter @workspace/web build
scripts.rust:check: node scripts/rust/run.mjs fmt --all -- --check && node scripts/rust/run.mjs clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && node scripts/rust/run.mjs test --locked --workspace
